light_description: STOMPROX first product; handmade low-noise overdrive designed to preserve low end and dynamics for professional use.
Bass overdrive derived from the BLACK LABEL concept, preserving original bass tone and low-end while adding focused drive.
Low-gain guitar overdrive combining crisp highs with chewy mids and a Color control for voicing changes.
Mid-forward 1980s/1990s Marshall-inspired drive with a rough, powerful response and strong touch sensitivity.
Bass overdrive with clean blend, strong low-end retention and a Color control that shifts the distorted frequency range.
Evolved Berial bass overdrive with a more refined/natural response and redesigned enclosure; retains blend and Color functions.
Modern distortion with noise gate and two-band active EQ, designed for aggressive multi-string and high-gain use.
Brown-sound distortion aimed at the early Van Halen era, with a dry, gritty high-gain character and 9-18V operation.
Bass fuzz developed around a Brassmaster-style octave concept, redesigned with modern filtering and clean blend controls.
